items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Freida Shaw and Band. Earl Thompson, and we had a violin player named Wilma Bratton.

ctx.x: Yes. Freida Shaw and Band. Earl Thompson, and we had a violin player named Wilma Bratton. She was a good violin player. But like I said, that was our schedule. We got $25 a week, $100 a month. They paid off every two weeks.
But you had your room and board.
